# Shared fixtures

Byte-for-byte copies of fixtures the other SDKs test against, so the three agree on the
wire. Never edit one here: refresh it from its source at the pinned commit
(`[tool.crowdypy.crowdyjs]` / `[tool.crowdypy.crowdycpp]` in `pyproject.toml`), and
`tests/unit/test_fixture_provenance.py` refuses a copy that differs from its source.

| file | source |
|---|---|
| `binary-wire-fixtures.json` | CrowdyJS `test/unit/fixtures/binary-wire-fixtures.json` (generated by the Game API's fixture generator; uplink encodings and downlink parses) |
| `exec-client-frames.json` | CrowdyJS `test/unit/fixtures/exec-client-frames.json`, identical to CrowdyCPP `tools/parity/fixtures/exec-client-frames.json` (ck-exec gateway frames) |
| `voice-frames.json` | CrowdyJS `test/unit/fixtures/voice-frames.json`, identical to CrowdyCPP `tools/parity/fixtures/voice-frames.json` (voice headers, the packetizer and the jitter buffer; `tests/unit/test_voice_frames.py` replays it) |

CrowdyCPP's own wire golden vectors (`kGoldenSpatial`, `kGoldenReconnect`, computed
independently from the public HMAC and wire-format docs) are reproduced inline in
`tests/unit/test_wire.py`, and the Studio fixtures come with the vendored tree under
`vendor/CrowdyCPP/tools/parity/fixtures/`.
